principle_violations.reason: The PaymentProcessor class encapsulates multiple responsibilities: processing payments and handling authentication via SMS. This makes the class harder to maintain and extend.
principle_violations.suggestion: Separate the concerns of payment processing and SMS authentication into different classes, such as a separate AuthenticationService class.

principle_violations.reason: The PaymentProcessor class is not easily extensible to support new payment methods without modifying the existing class; it should be open for extension and closed for modification.
principle_violations.suggestion: Use the Strategy pattern to allow for adding new payment methods without modifying existing code. Each payment method implementing the PaymentProcessor interface can be added without changing the existing processing classes.

overall_feedback: 2 principle violations found. Please see the details below.
